script: The United States government made a secret deal with the mafia, and it took thirty years for anyone to prove it happened. In 1942, Nazi saboteurs were suspected of slipping into New York's harbor, and Naval Intelligence needed eyes on every dock in the city. The eyes they found belonged to the mob. Officials struck a deal with a mafia boss serving prison time: control the waterfront, and stop the saboteurs. In exchange, his sentence was quietly commuted, and a convicted criminal walked free. The public was told nothing. For thirty years, officials denied any deal ever existed. Then sworn testimony in 1954 forced the truth into the record. It took the government thirty years to admit the secret deal with the mafia had ever happened.
